notes: ARC-01 was accepted only because its estimator conventions could be back-solved from a pre-existing repository module. ARC-03 does NOT rely on that: every convention below is stated in full in this file and is reproducible from the frozen spec alone. Where a convention coincides with src/trading_bot/backtesting/stat_validation.py (present before this prereg) that is recorded as corroboration, never as a substitute for the definition.

sharpe.window_span_days_is_fixed_not_trade_deri: window_span_days is a FROZEN CONSTANT of the prereg, not the realized trade span; this removes ARC-01's window_days ambiguity
sharpe.zero_variance_behavior: if sample_std(net_returns, ddof=1) == 0.0 then annualized_sharpe = 0.0 and G5 FAILS (fail closed; no astronomic fabricated statistic)
sharpe.n_lt_2_behavior: if N < 2 then annualized_sharpe = 0.0 and G5 FAILS
sharpe.project_corroboration: src/trading_bot/backtesting/stat_validation.py:_sharpe uses ddof=1 and mean/std*sqrt(periods_per_year); with periods_per_year = trades_per_year this is identical

bootstrap.statistic: mean net trade return at PRIMARY_COST_BPS (the same statistic as G2)
bootstrap.resampling_unit: i.i.d. TRADE (one net-return observation per trade); not blocks, not daily aggregation
bootstrap.sampling: with replacement (true bootstrap), each resample of exactly N draws
bootstrap.construction: for each of R resamples, draw N indices i_k = rng.randrange(N) in sequence and compute the mean of net_returns[i_k]; sort the R statistics ascending
bootstrap.confidence_interval_construction: percentile method: lower_idx = max(0, floor(0.025 * R)); ci_lower = sorted_stats[lower_idx]
bootstrap.cross_check_reported: P(bootstrap mean > 0) = (#{statistic > 0}) / R, reported alongside (informational, not the gate)
bootstrap.degenerate_guard: if all trade returns are identical, the bootstrap is degenerate: ci_lower = 0.0 and G6 FAILS (fail closed)
bootstrap.overlapping_trades_note: trades are treated as exchangeable observations. Overlap is bounded by the frozen SKIP policy (at most one open position per asset, 12-bar holds), so cross-sectional dependence is limited to the 3 assets; the asset dimension is separately examined by G9 and by the frozen robustness plan. No block bootstrap is used, and none may be substituted ex post.
bootstrap.project_corroboration: src/trading_bot/backtesting/stat_validation.py:bootstrap_sharpe_ci uses random.Random(seed) and lower_idx = floor(alpha*R) on the sorted statistics

permutation.null_hypothesis: the net trade returns are symmetrically distributed about zero (no directional edge)
permutation.transform: independent random SIGN FLIP per trade: flipped_i = net_return_i * (+1 if rng.random() < 0.5 else -1)
permutation.statistic: mean of the flipped net trade returns
permutation.statistic_is_not_sharpe: The permutation statistic is deliberately the MEAN net trade return, not the Sharpe ratio. This is stated because the pre-existing project module happens to permute the Sharpe ratio; freezing the mean here makes G7 reproducible from this file alone and makes it the same functional as G2/G6.
permutation.sidedness: ONE-SIDED UPPER TAIL (the hypothesis is directional: positive net expectancy)
permutation.p_value_formula: p_value = (number of null statistics >= observed mean net trade return) / draws
permutation.no_plus_one_correction: the p-value uses exceed/draws with no additive continuity correction
permutation.degenerate_guard: if all trade returns are identical, p_value = 1.0 and G7 FAILS (fail closed)
permutation.overlapping_trades_note: the sign flip is applied per trade independently; the frozen SKIP policy bounds overlap and the same caveat as the bootstrap applies

profit_factor.definition: gross_profit / gross_loss where gross_profit = sum of net_trade_return over trades with net_trade_return > 0 and gross_loss = -sum of net_trade_return over trades with net_trade_return < 0
profit_factor.zero_loss_behavior: if gross_loss == 0 and gross_profit > 0 then PF = +infinity and G4 PASSES; if gross_loss == 0 and gross_profit == 0 then G4 FAILS
profit_factor.breakeven_reference: PF = 1.0 is breakeven; the frozen threshold is strictly above it

temporal_split.ordering: trades sorted by entry_time_ms ascending; ties broken by the frozen emission order (asset order BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT, then decision_time_ms)
temporal_split.quartile_boundaries: boundaries at floor(k*N/4) for k = 0,1,2,3,4; quartile k = trades[floor((k-1)*N/4) : floor(k*N/4)]
temporal_split.split_basis: EQUAL-COUNT chronological split of the TRADE TIMELINE (not a calendar split of the window)
temporal_split.quartiles_rule: >= 3 of the 4 quartile means > 0.0 (strict); with N < 4 the quartile test is not evaluable and G8 FAILS
temporal_split.empty_group_behavior: an empty group is not evaluable and G8 FAILS

concentration_attribution.denominator: total_net = sum of net_trade_return over all trades at PRIMARY_COST_BPS (unit-notional, so the sum of returns is PnL in notional units)
concentration_attribution.denominator_le_zero_behavior: if total_net <= 0 the shares are undefined; G10 FAILS (fail closed). This is not arbitrary: total_net <= 0 already implies G2 failure.
concentration_attribution.max_asset_share: max over assets of (sum of that asset's net returns) / total_net
concentration_attribution.max_calendar_month_share: each trade is attributed to the UTC calendar month of its ENTRY time (entry_time_ms); max over months of (month net sum) / total_net. Entry-time attribution is frozen explicitly to remove ARC-01's month-attribution ambiguity.
concentration_attribution.max_single_trade_share: max over trades of net_trade_return / total_net (negative components can never be the maximum when total_net > 0)

convention_bindings.aggregation: all aggregate statistics are EQUAL-WEIGHTED over trades (unit notional per trade); no compounding, no volatility targeting, no portfolio overlay

gates.name: sample sufficiency
gates.formula: N = number of executed trades; per-asset counts N_BTC, N_ETH, N_SOL

gates.name: net expectancy after costs
gates.metric: mean net trade return at PRIMARY_COST_BPS

gates.name: ex-funding expectancy
gates.purpose: ARC-03 must not pass merely by mechanically collecting funding carry; the price leg must carry the edge on its own

gates.name: bootstrap uncertainty
gates.metric: 95% percentile-bootstrap confidence interval of the mean net trade return

gates.name: permutation significance
gates.metric: one-sided sign-flip permutation p-value of the mean net trade return

gates.name: temporal stability
gates.metric: mean net trade return by chronological half and by chronological quartile

gates.name: asset stability
gates.metric: per-asset mean net trade return at PRIMARY_COST_BPS

gates.name: concentration
gates.metric: max asset share, max UTC-entry-month share, max single-trade share of total net return

gates.name: cost sensitivity
gates.metric: mean net trade return at 20 bps and at 40 bps on the IDENTICAL trade set

pass_condition: G1 AND G2 AND G3 AND G4 AND G5 AND G6 AND G7 AND G8 AND G9 AND G10 AND G11 AND (no control satisfies all critical gates)
fail_condition: any critical gate fails, OR the sample is insufficient, OR any required control satisfies all critical gates

controls_interaction.rule: controls are evaluated with the SAME gate set on their own trade sets; a control that satisfies ALL critical gates means the mechanism is not identified and the primary result is DISCOVERY_FAIL

non_gates.drawdown: computed as a DIAGNOSTIC OUTPUT ONLY if the frozen reporting requires it; it is NOT a critical discovery gate and no drawdown threshold may be invented after seeing a result
non_gates.post_hoc_cohorts: any cohort, asset, month or regime split not listed above is POST_HOC_LEAD_ONLY and cannot become a gate or a promotion

determinism_statement: Every gate above is a pure function of (the frozen trade set, the frozen cost scenarios, the frozen seeds). No gate depends on a runtime default, an unstated estimator, or an implementation-defined tie-break.
